scope: Complete frozen TRAIN + six internal judge-only video exclusions; size flag only; CPU; no detector/GPU training.
objective: wrong mean softplus(-s)+0.1/2||w||^2, intercept unpenalized; each fitting video correct mean softplus(s)/log(2)<=.05. Candidate accepts s<0, rejects s>=0.
solver: float64 strictly feasible log barrier Newton. Seven fixed mu stages .1 to 1e-7, <=100 iterations each; analytic derivatives, Armijo .0001, <=60 backtracks; independent KKT feasibility/stationarity/gap certificate. No search/restarts.
control: same three descriptors, fitting-only standardization and rows; original balanced Newton l2=.1 max100 grad1e-8; cutoff max FIT-video correct95 quantile. full_simple is historical all-TRAIN trained reference, not an honest held-out judge.
gate: Every held video correct retention>=95%; sum per-video offline correct95 FA strictly below current matching 3D control54; per-video same-correct95 FA no worse than control; actual working point FA no worse than controls at same count and same CR; longest correct FR no worse at same CR. Feasible all-accept alone is failure. Equality allowed per video but total FA must improve.
next_stage: Only fixed candidate passing TRAIN gate can proceed to complete VAL in a separately recorded stage; failure stops. No TEST selection or automatic deployment.
limitations: Historical VAL/TEST repeatedly exposed, neither parsed here. TRAIN detector saw all videos; exclusion tests judge transfer only.
Empirical bound applies only fitting-video FR. No future-video guarantee; dependent frames not iid.
Conservative surrogate can force all accept and cannot add information. Not a complete Neyman-Pearson implementation.
Offline sameCR/count and correct95 are GT comparisons, never online GT thresholds. Fold-specific scores not pooled into AUC.
Formal boxes/score/count/center/angle/policy/depth unchanged. Native cache merely checked by inherited loader, not fitted.
